clue.text: Celebrated with formal do after crashing our party

indicators.note: the shuffled formal do gatecrashes, entering between the letters for with and our

parts.note: US is the object form of we, so it stands for our group

indicators.note: a party is a lively, disorderly affair, so the words formal do are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Someone becomes a celebrity after gatecrashing a formal dinner held by our group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'party' (a riotous do) rearranges the words formal do, and 'crashing' sends that mix gatecrashing between the letters for with and our.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone celebrated is famous everywhere, known across the whole globe.

clue.text: Spring plant

definitions.meaning: to spring is to jump lightly, as a verb
the climbing vine whose cones flavour beer

explanation.definitionFit: A hop is both a small spring or jump and the climbing plant used in brewing.

clue.text: Gladiator's pole useless without short nail

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so pole and useless sit around the short nail

parts.note: a spar is a pole, as on a ship
US is short for unserviceable, meaning useless

indicators.note: short means the word for nail loses its last letter

parts.note: a tack is a small nail

explanation.surface: A gladiator's pole is no use without a nail to fix it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside. Gladiator's is the definition with its possessive: the Thracian slave who led the revolt.
explanation.definitionFit: The Thracian slave who led the revolt against Rome was trained as a gladiator.

clue.text: Mistake forgetting name: one may have blown it!

indicators.note: forgetting means the letter for name is left out of the word for mistake

parts.note: a bungle is a botched job or mistake

explanation.surface: Someone who makes a mistake and forgets a name might be said to have blown it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forgetting' removes N from BUNGLE. 'Blown it' looks like failure, but a bugle is literally blown.
explanation.definitionFit: A brass instrument is something a player blows, the exclamation marking the pun on blowing it.

clue.text: Retiring briefly to consume roast in part of kitchen?

indicators.note: to consume is to take inside, so the shortened word for retiring swallows the word for roast
briefly means the word for retiring is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: retiring means shy or timid
to roast a show is to criticise it harshly, to pan it

explanation.surface: A shy cook going off to eat a roast in a corner of the kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: Orchestral players nickname the percussion section the kitchen, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Kettledrums belong to the orchestral percussion section, nicknamed the kitchen by musicians.

clue.text: Attempt to deceive Poles that hurts career

parts.note: S and N are the south and north poles
ow is the cry when something hurts
a job is a career or occupation

explanation.surface: An attempt to fool Polish workers that damages their careers.
explanation.definitionFit: In American slang this is a persuasive, flattering deception meant to mislead someone.

clue.text: Cockney's welcome tip for military brass maybe

parts.note: a Cockney drops the h of hello, saying allo

indicators.note: tip here is the end of the word military, its final letter

explanation.surface: A Cockney greets someone and gives a tip to military top brass.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockneys, working-class Londoners, drop their h. 'Brass maybe' looks like army officers but is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Brass, a mix of copper and zinc, is an example of a blended metal.

clue.text: Unexciting, joining Queen Mary for one cocktail

parts.note: flat means dull or unexciting
the Queen Mary is a famous ocean liner

explanation.surface: Drinking a dull cocktail aboard the Queen Mary.
explanation.definitionFit: A layered shot of tequila and sambuca with Tabasco is sold under this name.

clue.text: Fist's sound punches hit players

annotationWithheld.why: Fist's sound punches hit players (9): BOXES for punches and def hit players are clear, but no parse of Fist's sound gives JUKE

clue.text: For boy or girl it's a bit of a laugh

parts.note: it means sex appeal, SA, so it's gives SA's
ha is one part of a ha-ha laugh

explanation.surface: Something suitable for a boy or a girl is only a bit of fun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It' as sex appeal (SA) is a crossword staple; with the 's attached it gives SAS.
explanation.definitionFit: This Russian pet form of Alexander or Alexandra serves as a first name for either sex.

clue.text: A visiting Church of Ireland minister, one hosting moderator?

indicators.note: a visitor goes inside someone's home, so A enters the minister

parts.note: a rector is the minister of a parish in the Church of Ireland

explanation.surface: A visitor calls on an Irish clergyman who is hosting a church moderator.
explanation.walkthrough: A moderator is also a church official, but here it is the substance that slows neutrons in a nuclear core.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuclear power unit contains a moderator such as graphite or water to slow neutrons.

clue.text: Church mostly dubious about material

indicators.note: mostly means the word for dubious loses its last letter

parts.note: iffy is informal for dubious
on means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A church is doubtful about the fabric it has chosen.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a light, sheer fabric of silk or nylon.

clue.text: Fabulous flower which ordinarily needs trimming all round

indicators.note: trimming the outer letters away from the run of words leaves the inner part as the answer

explanation.surface: A mythical bloom that normally has to be pruned on every side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' is something that flows, not a bloom, and 'fabulous' means from fable.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the gods have this ethereal fluid flowing in their veins instead of blood.

clue.text: Relative needing sum of money doubled annually

parts.note: a grand is a thousand pounds or dollars

indicators.note: doubled means the abbreviation for annually is written twice

parts.note: PA is per annum, Latin for yearly

explanation.surface: A relative needs a sum of money that doubles every year.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned name for one's grandfather, a family member.

clue.text: Landed in time after journey

indicators.note: after means the letter for time follows the word for journey

parts.note: a go is a trip or turn, as in have a go

explanation.surface: Arrived on schedule after a trip.
explanation.definitionFit: To land something, such as a job or a fish, is to obtain or secure it.

clue.text: Released short piece of Koran, translated

indicators.note: short means the word for a chapter of the Koran loses its last letter

parts.note: a sura is a chapter of the Koran
to render a text is to translate it

explanation.surface: A short passage of the Koran is released in translation.
explanation.definitionFit: To give up or hand over something is to let it go, releasing control.

clue.text: Is no longer dated when done up

indicators.note: in a down entry, done up means written upwards, so the word is reversed

parts.note: if you saw someone you went out with them, so saw means dated

explanation.surface: Something that is out of date looks old even after being refurbished.
explanation.definitionFit: The past tense form tells us something existed before but not now.

clue.text: Once again, prime minister's back in the papers

indicators.note: in means the back letter of minister is put inside the word for the papers

parts.note: a ream is a bundle of paper sheets

indicators.note: back means the final letter of minister

explanation.surface: Once again the prime minister is back in the newspapers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prime minister' looks like one phrase, but prime belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To prime a weapon is to ready it; to supply weapons again is to arm afresh.

clue.text: Shrub needs air after pruning, no matter what

indicators.note: pruning means the word for air is cut back by its last letter

parts.note: an air is a tune, a ditty
any means whichever one, no matter what

explanation.surface: A shrub needs air after being pruned, whatever happens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after pruning' trims the tune word by one letter at its end; 'needs' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: This aromatic plant of the mint family, from Crete, is a low bushy herb.

clue.text: Bend and twitch following bovine creature

parts.note: an arc is a curve or bend
a tic is an involuntary twitch
F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
an ox is a bovine animal

explanation.surface: A bovine animal bends and twitches behind another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following' looks like a position word, but gives F, so bovine creature is not the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: This white-coated polar canine is an animal, a wild creature of the Arctic.

clue.text: These sanctuaries requiring patients to complete a circle?

indicators.note: the letter C looks like a broken ring, so closing it makes the letter O

parts.note: a doctor's cases are the patients

explanation.surface: Sanctuaries that need their patients to sit in a full circle.
explanation.walkthrough: C is a circle with a gap; complete it and it becomes O.
explanation.definitionFit: Places of refuge or relief, like fertile spots in a desert, are havens.

clue.text: People standing in something greasy that's under the bed?

parts.note: subs are substitutes, people who stand in
oil is a greasy substance

explanation.surface: Stand-ins find something greasy under a bed.
explanation.walkthrough: The bed is not furniture but a bed of earth or a river bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The layer of earth beneath the topsoil lies below a garden bed.

clue.text: Fun and games school heads curse aloud

indicators.note: heads means the word for school goes in front

parts.note: a high is a high school

indicators.note: aloud means the word for curse is said, giving letters that sound the same

parts.note: a jinx is a curse

explanation.surface: Fun and games at school as the head teachers curse out loud.
explanation.definitionFit: Boisterous merrymaking or high-spirited capers are lively fun.

clue.text: On-field parking: pub to profit in legal arrangement

indicators.note: On means the letter for parking goes on top of the word for field, in front

parts.note: a lea is a meadow or field
a bar is a pub
to gain is to profit

explanation.surface: Parking on a field by the pub is a profitable legal deal.
explanation.definitionFit: A deal in court where a defendant admits guilt for a lighter sentence.

clue.text: Sentimental fool rushing hugs

indicators.note: to hug is to hold inside, so the word for rushing wraps the word for fool

parts.note: tearing means rushing
a jerk is a fool

explanation.surface: A sentimental fool hurrying about hugging people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sentimental fool' looks like a noun phrase, but fool is wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Something mawkish or overly emotional that makes people weep.

clue.text: Appreciates baking, consuming article willingly

indicators.note: consuming means the joined words hold the article inside

parts.note: likes means appreciates
A is the indefinite article
baking means very hot

explanation.surface: Someone who loves baking eats up an article eagerly.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom meaning very quickly and readily, without hesitation.

clue.text: Reorganised a case so it's not full

indicators.note: reorganised means the letters of the following words are put in a new order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A legal case is reorganised so it is no longer full.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of it's adds no letter; the nine letters A CASE SO IT are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: An associate member of a club has partial, not full, membership.

clue.text: One after another's purchase, we hear, acts

indicators.note: we hear means the word for purchase is taken by its sound

parts.note: to buy is to purchase
turns are acts in a variety show

explanation.surface: Someone else's purchase is something we hear performed as stage acts.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of another's is a link meaning has.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for taking turns, alternately, in succession.

clue.text: Made slip son had on

parts.note: to have someone on is to tease or kid them

explanation.surface: A son made a slip on account of having something on.
explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle that slides out of control has made a slip on the road.

clue.text: Chap received …

definitions.meaning: a man's name, standing for any chap
the radio word acknowledging a message as received

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a male first name and the radio signal for message understood.

clue.text: gift — just wrapping left

indicators.note: wrapping means the word for just goes around the letter for left

parts.note: fair means just

explanation.surface: A gift that is just wrapping, left over.
explanation.definitionFit: A natural talent or knack is a gift.

clue.text: A hand produced by girl, scratching head

indicators.note: scratching means removing, so the word for girl loses its first letter

parts.note: a maid is a girl

explanation.surface: A hand produced by a girl who scratches her head.
explanation.definitionFit: To give a hand is to help, so a hand is assistance.
